text: The Japan national teams' official Canterbury jerseys are designed and manufactured by Goldwin Inc., which develops the Canterbury brand in Japan and is an official partner of both the men's and women's national teams.
short: Canterbury's Japan jerseys are designed and made by Goldwin Inc.

source.name: Japan Rugby Football Union: ラグビー日本代表ジャージー新デザインを発表 ～ホームジャージーのデザインテーマは歌舞伎～ (Japan national team jersey new design announced)
source.quote: ラグビー日本代表のオフィシャルジャージーは、男女日本代表オフィシャルパートナーで「Canterbury」ブランドを展開する株式会社ゴールドウイン（代表取締役社長：渡辺貴生、東京都港区）によってデザイン製作されました
source.note: JRFU announcement of the current home jersey design (debut July 2025). English: 'The official jersey of the Japan national rugby team is designed and manufactured by Goldwin Inc., the company that develops the Canterbury brand and is an official partner of both the men's and women's national teams.' Goldwin's own company outline (about.goldwin.co.jp/about/company) lists it as listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market, securities code 8111.
